technical.summary: Isolated bullish signals (supertrend, hull, cmf cross) lack confluence; price remains below all key moving averages with negative momentum indicators and no trend strength, making this a low-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 68 days present material risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak bearish congressional signal from junior Democratic members selling small positions 97-106 days ago; neutral market sentiment and absent news data provide no confirmation or contradiction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (186.88) indicates extreme market stress, strong USD pressures multinational earnings, and recent CPI miss adds uncertainty; 68-day earnings window provides some buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend, Hull MA, and CMF cross-up provide isolated early bullish signals with price near support (84.67) offering defined risk entry if macro conditions stabilize.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with negative momentum (RSI 41, MACD -1.52, stoch bearish cross), zero trend strength (ADX 17), and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong USD) create overwhelming confluence of sell signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Isolated bullish technicals (supertrend, hull, cmf cross) lack confluence and occur within a price structure trapped below all major moving averages with zero trend strength (ADX 17). Macro environment is severely unfavourable with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and strong USD headwinds that override localized technical signals.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro deterioration (recession signals, VIX crisis, inverted yield curve) combined with negative momentum (RSI 41, MACD -1.52, stoch bearish cross) creates high probability of breakdown below support at 84.67 before any bullish reversal materializes.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; technical weakness, fundamental void, weak sentiment, and crisis-level macro all point to avoidance
